archer_bear_trap.upgrade_description: Place a trap that deals ATK 3 and ROOT. Upgraded: trapped enemies suffer VULNERABLE.

archer_caltrop_trap.upgrade_description: Place a trap that applies ROOT and BLEED WPN. Upgraded trap also applies -2 DEF.

archer_explosive_arrow.upgrade_description: Destroy terrain; upgraded ignites flammable terrain/oil.

archer_grapple_arrow.upgrade_description: Shoot a wall/obstacle to PULL SELF adjacent. Upgraded: pass through enemy for ATK 2.

archer_hunters_mark.upgrade_description: Allies gain RANGE +1 and PIERCE against the target. Upgraded target cannot gain STEALTH or Teleport.

archer_parting_shot.upgrade_description: After attacking, immediately MOVE 2 tiles. Upgraded movement gains GHOST.

archer_piercing_shot.upgrade_description: Arrow bounces off walls at a 45-degree angle.

archer_pinning_arrow.upgrade_description: ROOT breaks on damage. If target is PUSHED while Rooted, apply BLEED WPN.

archer_power_shot.upgrade_description: Enemy collision applies PIERCE and ATK 2 to the second enemy.

archer_repelling_shot.upgrade_description: On an ally, deal ATK 0 and PUSH 3.

archer_scouts_eye.upgrade_description: Strip STEALTH and PURGE buffs. Upgraded target suffers VULNERABLE.

archer_sidestep.upgrade_description: Your next ranged attack gains +1 STR.

archer_suppressing_fire.upgrade_description: Create a one-turn hazard line; crossing enemies suffer WPN unmitigated damage and -1 MOV. Upgraded also BLINDs.

archer_toxic_spore_arrow.upgrade_description: Apply POISON. Upgraded: spread POISON to adjacent enemies on hit.

archer_volley.upgrade_description: Area becomes difficult terrain (MOVE cost x2).

lightfoot.description: Spend MOV equal to Max MOV while standing still to gain +1 RANGE and +1 STR for attacks this turn.
lightfoot.upgraded_description: Gain +2 RANGE, +2 STR, and PIERCE instead.

area_denial.description: Traps, Hazard Lines, and Difficult Terrain you create apply ROOT and WPN unmitigated damage.
area_denial.upgraded_description: Those created traps also apply POISON.

barrage.description: Exact lethal damage immediately deals ATK 1 to the next nearest enemy.

camouflage.description: If you spend 0 MOV, gain STEALTH for attacks beyond RANGE 3 until next turn.
camouflage.upgraded_description: Next attack out of STEALTH gains +2 STR.

fletching_hoarder.description: Moving over an enemy corpse empowers the next attack by +2 STR.
fletching_hoarder.upgraded_description: Empowers the next attack by +3 STR instead.

high_ground.description: Attacking from elevation grants +1 RANGE and ignores 50% of target DEF.
high_ground.upgraded_description: Attacking from elevation grants +1 RANGE and ignores 50% of target DEF.

overwatch.description: If you end planning without spending AP, the first enemy entering your line of sight automatically suffers ATK 1.
overwatch.upgraded_description: If you end planning without spending AP, the first enemy entering your line of sight automatically suffers ATK 1.

patient_hunter.description: Triggering Steady Aim grants STURDY and STEALTH against enemies further than 3 tiles away until your next turn.

piercing_momentum.description: Attacks traveling 4 or more tiles before hitting gain PIERCE.
piercing_momentum.upgraded_description: Attacks traveling 4 or more tiles before hitting gain PIERCE.

prey_sighted.description: Attacks against movement-penalized enemies gain +2 STR and ignore 2 DEF.

sticky_mud.description: Difficult terrain you create costs +1 MOVE and removes FEAR.
sticky_mud.upgraded_description: Difficult terrain you create also applies ROOT.

target_painter.description: Attacks against debuffed enemies gain +2 STR.

true_sight.description: Attacks ignore cover bonuses and STEALTH.
true_sight.upgraded_description: Attacks ignore cover bonuses and STEALTH.

zone_control.description: Enemies entering RANGE 3 suffer 1 unmitigated damage and PUSH 1 backward.

bruiser_adrenaline_surge.upgrade_description: On Kill: HEAL 1 and gain SHIELD 2.

bruiser_belly_flop.upgrade_description: Landing applies PUSH 1 to all adjacent enemies.

bruiser_blood_boil.upgrade_description: Spend 10 HP to gain STR +5 instead.

bruiser_breaching_dash.upgrade_description: Your next attack this turn gains PIERCE.

bruiser_charge_strike.upgrade_description: Gain GHOST during MOVE. Gain ATK +2 if passing through terrain.

bruiser_cleave.upgrade_description: Apply BLEED X (where X = your WPN) to all targets.

bruiser_concussion_blow.upgrade_description: Enemy collision applies STAGGER to both units.

bruiser_crimson_whirlwind.upgrade_description: HEAL 1 for every target successfully hit.

bruiser_guttural_roar.upgrade_description: PUSH 1 all items/coins/scrap. Item collision: ATK 1.

bruiser_headbutt.upgrade_description: Deal bonus damage equal to 10% of your Max HP.

bruiser_push_through.upgrade_description: Cost reduced to 1 MOV. Pushing unit grants +1 STR for next attack.

bruiser_suplex.upgrade_description: Gain ATK +1 for every 10 Current HP you possess.

cellular_regeneration.description: At the start of every turn, restore 5% of Max HP.
cellular_regeneration.upgraded_description: [+] Restore 10%; at full HP convert the excess into SHIELD.

adrenaline_junkie.description: Gain MOVE +1 and STR +1 per 10% missing HP.
adrenaline_junkie.upgraded_description: [+] Also gain +1 DEF for every 20% missing HP.

battering_ram.upgraded_description: [+] Pushed enemies hitting walls suffer STAGGER.

blood_for_blood.description: If damaged last turn, attacks apply BLEED X (X = WPN).

colossal_mass.description: Gain +1 STR for every 15 Max HP.
colossal_mass.upgraded_description: [+] Gain +1 STR for every 10 Max HP instead.

crowd_breaker.description: +1 STR per adjacent enemy. Splash damage ATK 1.

juggernaut.description: Moving over traps destroys them for 0 damage.

last_stand.description: When HP < 25%, gain +2 STR and +2 DEF.

momentum_of_titan.description: PUSH collision adds damage = 10% Max HP.

overwhelming_bulk.description: If Current HP > target Max HP, physical attacks gain PIERCE.

reactive_adrenaline.description: Starting adjacent to enemies converts Sanguine Regeneration into SHIELD and grants +1 STR per adjacent enemy, up to +3.
reactive_adrenaline.upgraded_description: [+] Also gain +1 DEF per adjacent enemy.

scar_tissue.description: Reduce physical damage by 1 per 20 Max HP or missing HP.

thrill_of_pain.description: Damage taken adds ATK +2 and PUSH 1 to NEXT attack.

unstoppable_force.description: Immune to STAGGER/ROOT. Resisting grants SHIELD 1.

knight_chain_hook.upgrade_description: Target suffers VULNERABLE if pulled adjacent.

knight_shield_bash.upgrade_description: Apply STAGGER if collides with wall/enemy.

knight_swap.upgrade_description: Gain +2 DEF and SHIELD 2 for the rest of the turn.

collision_retaliator.description: Take 0 collision damage. Physical damage from the frontal arc within 3 tiles gains +2 DEF mitigation.
collision_retaliator.upgraded_description: [+] Frontal mitigation increases to +4 DEF and collision grants SHIELD 2.

concussive_shatter.description: Enemy collision suffers extra damage equal to 50% of your DEF, and target loses -1 DEF.

intercept_tactics.description: Using a redirect skill grants +2 DEF.

kinetic_armor.description: Incoming damage reduced by flat 1 if SHIELD active.

kinetic_converter.description: When hit, gain STR +1 and MOVE +1 for next turn.

kinetic_dissipation.description: When pushed or knocked into an obstacle or unit, gain SHIELD equal to DEF and trigger a 1-tile shockwave dealing physical damage equal to DEF.
kinetic_dissipation.upgraded_description: [+] The enemy is also PUSHED 1 tile.

kinetic_momentum.description: Causing an enemy to suffer collision damage grants SHIELD equal to your STR + DEF for 1 turn.
kinetic_momentum.upgraded_description: [+] Also refunds 1 MOV point on your first collision each turn.

kinetic_redirection.description: Mitigating damage adds +1 STR to next attack (Stacks to +3).

living_barricade.description: Allies behind are immune to ranged attacks.

rallying_presence.description: Allies starting turn adjacent gain +1 MOV.

shield_mastery.description: When mitigating frontal damage with DEF or SHIELD, store 50% of mitigated damage as Kinetic Energy, capped at 2 * DEF.

shield_wall.description: Adjacent allies gain +1 DEF and PULL immunity.

stand_ground.description: Immune to PUSH/PULL. Enemy attempts trigger COUNTER ATTACK 1.

thorny_carapace.description: Melee hit reflects 50% damage (rounded down) & PUSH 1.

lancer_brace.upgrade_description: Your MOVEMENT becomes 0 this turn. The next incoming melee attack is negated; attacker suffers ATK 2.

lancer_glorious_charge.upgrade_description: On Kill: both the Lancer and the allied charger gain +1 AP.

lancer_harpoon_toss.upgrade_description: If SELF has ROOT or target is heavier, PULL SELF to target.

lancer_line_breaker.upgrade_description: ATK +1 for each enemy passed through this turn.

lancer_piercing_charge.upgrade_description: Create TRAMPLED terrain behind you (MOVE cost x2). If Push was used earlier this turn, PUSH 3 instead.

lancer_pole_vault.upgrade_description: If Push was used earlier this turn, landing applies PUSH 1 to adjacent enemies; collisions STAGGER.

lancer_push.upgrade_description: Limit once per turn. Pushing a unit grants +1 STR for your next attack this turn.

lancer_spear_wall.upgrade_description: Hazard line lasts for 2 turns instead of 1.

lancer_sweeping_halberd.upgrade_description: Sweeping Halberd's PULL collision applies STAGGER. If Push was used earlier this turn, PULL 2 instead.

lancer_vaulting_leap.upgrade_description: Armor explodes: ATK 1 in AOE 1 around the target.

polearm_mastery.description: Basic attacks have RANGE 2. Extended-reach attacks deal 30% less damage at RANGE 1.
polearm_mastery.upgraded_description: Attacks from exactly RANGE 2 gain +1 STR and ignore 2 DEF.

crashing_impact.description: Landing from a jump applies PUSH 1 to all adjacent enemies.
crashing_impact.upgraded_description: Landing from a jump applies PUSH 1 to all adjacent enemies; wall collisions apply STAGGER.

disengage.description: If forced to attack at RANGE 1, PUSH yourself 1 before damage.
disengage.upgraded_description: If forced to attack at RANGE 1, PUSH yourself 1 before damage, then PUSH the enemy 1.

flanking_strike.description: Attacks originating from the side of an enemy ignore 2 DEF.
flanking_strike.upgraded_description: Attacks originating from the side of an enemy ignore 4 DEF instead.

frontline_defense.description: Gain +1 DEF and immunity to Ranged attacks if moved 3+ tiles.
frontline_defense.upgraded_description: Gain +1 DEF and immunity to Ranged attacks if moved 3+ tiles. Also gain SHIELD 1.

kinetic_charge.description: Gain +1 STR for every tile moved in a continuous straight line before attacking this turn.
kinetic_charge.upgraded_description: Gain +1 STR for every tile moved in a continuous straight line before attacking this turn.

leverage.description: Using your 0-AP Push grants your next attack PIERCE and +1 MOV.
leverage.upgraded_description: Using your 0-AP Push grants your next attack PIERCE, +1 MOV, and SHIELD 1.

plunging_attack.description: If you use an AP jump or teleport, your next basic attack this turn gains +3 ATK.
plunging_attack.upgraded_description: If you use an AP jump or teleport, your next basic attack this turn gains +3 ATK and PIERCE.

pole_plant.description: Your 0-AP Push can target destructible obstacles and traps. Destroying a trap grants SHIELD 2.
pole_plant.upgraded_description: Destroying a trap also deals 2 unmitigated damage to adjacent enemies.

reach_advantage.description: When attacking a melee unit from exactly RANGE 2, they cannot trigger standard counter-attacks or Retaliation.
reach_advantage.upgraded_description: When attacking a melee unit from exactly RANGE 2, they cannot trigger standard counter-attacks or Retaliation.

spear_drop.description: Attacking an enemy you vaulted over ignores 2 DEF and applies BLEED X, where X is WPN.
spear_drop.upgraded_description: Attacking an enemy you vaulted over ignores 4 DEF and applies BLEED X, where X is WPN.

springboard.description: On Kill: you may vault into the defeated enemy's space for 0 AP and gain +1 MOV on landing.
springboard.upgraded_description: On Kill: you may vault into the defeated enemy's space for 0 AP, gain +1 MOV, and gain 1 AP on landing once per turn.

sweet_spot.description: Attacks from exactly RANGE 2 apply PUSH 1 and reduce the target's MOV by 2. Wall or obstacle collision applies STAGGER.

unstoppable_mass.description: If you move your maximum MOVEMENT before attacking, your attack gains PIERCE and you gain ROOT immunity for 1 turn.
unstoppable_mass.upgraded_description: If you move your maximum MOVEMENT before attacking, your attack gains PIERCE and you gain ROOT immunity for 1 turn.

zone_of_control.description: If an enemy ends movement exactly 2 tiles away during the Enemy Turn, make a basic attack once per round.
zone_of_control.upgraded_description: If an enemy ends movement exactly 2 tiles away during the Enemy Turn, make a basic attack with PIERCE once per round.
